title: Understanding Single Linkage
text: Single linkage clustering merges clusters based on the shortest distance between any two points in the clusters. Consider the distances between Team Pandas and the other teams.

title: Calculate Distances
text: Calculate the Euclidean distance between Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$ and the other teams: Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$, Team SantaQlaus $$(3,1)$$, and Team Ice-berk $$(1,5)$$.

title: Distance to Team O-Ski
text: Use the formula for Euclidean distance: $$`\sqrt{\left(x2-x1\right)^2+\left(y2-y1\right)^2}`$$. Calculate the distance between Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$ and Team O-Ski $$(1,1)$$.

title: Distance to Team SantaQlaus
text: Calculate the distance between Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$ and Team SantaQlaus $$(3,1)$$ using the Euclidean distance formula.

title: Distance to Team Ice-berk
text: Calculate the distance between Team Pandas $$(5,4)$$ and Team Ice-berk $$(1,5)$$ using the Euclidean distance formula.

title: Identify Closest Team
text: Based on the calculated distances, identify which team is closest to Team Pandas using single linkage.

title: Forming Clusters
text: Using single linkage, form clusters by merging the closest teams first. Which team is clustered with Team Pandas?
